mapper.update: UPDATE goods_sku SET stock = stock - #{qty}, lock_stock = IFNULL(lock_stock, 0) + #{qty}, version = IFNULL(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{skuId} AND del_flag = '0' AND stock >= #{qty}
UPDATE goods_sku SET stock = stock + #{qty}, lock_stock = IFNULL(lock_stock, 0) - #{qty}, version = IFNULL(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{skuId} AND del_flag = '0' AND IFNULL(lock_stock, 0) >= #{qty}
